title: Biodiversity loss and the Red List
quote: The most important cause is habitat loss

boxes.title: Extinction facts
items: **Sixth extinction**: human-driven; **tens to hundreds of times** background (IPBES)
Fifth: end-Cretaceous, about **66 million** years ago
IUCN **2014**: **784** extinctions in **500** years
==**Cheetah** extinct in India **1952**==; Asiatic cheetah only in **Iran**
Also lost from India: **pink-headed duck**, **mountain quail**
Invasives: about **40%** of animal extinctions; India damage **$127.3 billion**

levels.name: EX → EW
levels.note: Extinct; Extinct in the Wild (captivity only)

boxes.title: IUCN & Red List
items: IUCN: **1948**, ==**Gland, Switzerland**== (APPSC 2025); not a UN agency
Red List started **1964**: "**Barometer of Life**"
Pink pages = **CR**; green pages = recovered
Criteria **A-E**: decline, range, small population, very small, quantitative
India Roadmap: **70,000** species by **2027** (NBA)

boxes.title: Species status
head: Category
Species
rows: **Great Indian Bustard** (Rollapadu), **Gharial**, Hangul, Jerdon's Courser, Gooty tarantula
**Red Sanders**, Asiatic lion (from CR), tiger, red panda, lion-tailed macaque

boxes.title: AP angle
items: Bauxite mining: **Eastern Ghats**; granite quarrying: Seshachalam, Nallamala
**Kolleru** (Ramsar **2002**): fish and prawn tanks
Gooty tarantula: **fewer than 300**; range **< 100 sq km**
Jerdon's Courser: **Sri Lankamalleswara WLS**; ⚠ not flightless
AP state tree is **Neem**, not Red Sanders

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: CR = ==Critically Endangered==, not "critically extinct" (APPSC 2023, 2025)
Red List, not brown/white/black list (APPSC 2025)
Not a threat: **vegetarianism**; not extinction cause: loss of appetite
Schedule IV = CITES specimens, ⚠ not invasives; IAS under **Section 62A**
First community invasive-fish removal: **Ujani**, Maharashtra
